title: North District Clinic: Unverified MMR Dose — 10-Year-Old Boy with Rash

transcript.speaker: Nurse Carla
transcript.text: Dr. Raman, this is Nurse Carla at the North District Clinic. We have a 10-year-old boy in the lobby with a fever and a rash. He says he had his first MMR dose on March 15th, but there’s no record of a second dose in ClinicTrack or on paper. The MCHD-F-40 form for dose documentation was not completed. He has no other immunization history. We’re under standing orders to vaccinate children who have only had one dose if they are not immune. Do we vaccinate him now, or wait for verification? Parents are starting to leave.

transcript.speaker: Dr. Neha Raman
transcript.text: Nurse Carla, hold him. We need to confirm immunity status immediately. I’ll check the paper record and contact the Medical Director. Do not administer a second dose without approval. The standing order is SO-MEA-03, which requires verification by the Medical Director before vaccination under incomplete documentation. I’ll call back within two minutes.

instructorNote: This inject tests the Epi team’s adherence to standing orders and paper-mode protocols. The child is not immune; the Epi team must escalate to the Medical Director, not proceed under SO-MEA-03 without approval.
